description: NodeState: createState configs set and read on nodes (values and updaters), defaults left out of the JSON, the `$` JSON round trip with keys no config reads, reading and copying such keys, $copyNode and history, text nodes merging or splitting by their NodeState, a key collision, a flat state, segmented text made plain, and hashtags taking NodeState from their text.

cases.name: JSON with keys no config has read
text nodes merge only with equivalent NodeState
merging compares unread JSON values by identity
splitText gives the parts the NodeState
segmented text made plain keeps its NodeState
hashtags take the NodeState of their text
text split off a hashtag and a hashtag turned into text
